test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The army retreated to their strategic __bases__ before launching a counterattack.

options.text: She applied two coats of makeup bases before the foundation.
Allied forces established new bases along the coastline.
The soldiers returned to their airforce bases for regrouping.
The navy had to defend its remaining overseas bases.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"bases"** in the question refers to strategic military locations or centers where operations are conducted. (आधार स्थल)
 
 
• **Example:** The army retreated to their strategic bases before launching a counterattack.
 
 
 
• The word **"bases"** in Option 1 refers to the initial layers applied in makeup before foundation. (आधार परत)
 
 
• **Example:** She applied two coats of makeup bases before the foundation to ensure smooth coverage.
